title: Notifications, announcements and operations

surfaces.name: Notification bell/dropdown — desktop (all roles)
surfaces.notes: Legacy: custom portal overlay below bell, badge count, 8 most-recent items, TypeTag, relative date. vNext: notification-list component used. Bell trigger and badge exist in layout.

surfaces.name: Notification bell/drawer — mobile (all roles)
surfaces.notes: Legacy: Ant Design Drawer full-width on mobile (<=767px). vNext needs same responsive drawer pattern.

surfaces.name: Notification detail modal (all roles)
surfaces.notes: Legacy: ModalContainer with title, HTML body via Markup, type tag, course name, date. Primary action buttons: Take Assessment / View Interview / View in My Applications. Secondary: View in My Applications. vNext: Dialog-based detail.

surfaces.name: Notification panel — loading skeleton
surfaces.notes: Legacy: ListSkeleton rows=4, RefreshStatus for partial reload. vNext has animate-pulse skeleton rows.

surfaces.name: Notification panel — empty state (all roles)
surfaces.notes: Legacy: BellOutlined icon, title='No notifications yet', configurable description. vNext needs same empty state.

surfaces.name: Notification panel — error state
surfaces.notes: Legacy: PanelError with retry button when no data; PanelPartial when stale data exists.

surfaces.name: Learner notifications page (full list)
surfaces.notes: Legacy: tabbed list (Course, Project, Announcement, Job tabs). Learner tabs. Full page version of drawer content with type filtering. vNext: LearnerNotificationsInbox with tabs.

surfaces.name: Learner notification history sub-page
surfaces.notes: vNext-only sub-page. No direct legacy equivalent. Log of older notifications.

surfaces.notes: Legacy: Faculty uses NotificationsContent with FACULTY_TAB_LABELS (College, Department, Faculty, Personal). vNext: teacher notifications page.

surfaces.name: Mentor notifications page
surfaces.notes: Legacy: same NotificationsContent component. vNext: mentor notifications page.

surfaces.notes: Legacy: NotificationsContent. vNext: tpo notifications with NotificationList, NotificationToolbar, TPO_NOTIFICATIONS_PATH model.

surfaces.notes: No legacy equivalent for HR notifications page. vNext has page stub. Must verify existence of content.

surfaces.notes: vNext-only shared notifications base route. No legacy equivalent at /notifications.

surfaces.name: SuperAdmin announcements page (Placements > Announcements)
surfaces.notes: Legacy: AnnouncementList mode=superadmin, 'New announcement' button, AsyncModal for create/edit. Recipients = placement cells. Reads progress shown. vNext: AnnouncementAdminWorkspace, SuperAdminCollegeBroadcastForm.

surfaces.name: SuperAdmin create announcement modal
surfaces.notes: Legacy fields: Title, Announcement body (6 rows), To (ALL/SOME radio), College picker (conditional), Button label+URL, Show until DatePicker, Pinned checkbox. Submit: 'Send to every placement cell (N)' or 'Send to the picked placement cells'. vNext: TpoNoticeComposerDialog.

surfaces.name: SuperAdmin edit announcement modal
surfaces.notes: Legacy: edit strips audience picker, shows Alert with 'Sent to N placement cells'. Submit: 'Save'. vNext: same dialog in edit mode.

surfaces.name: SuperAdmin delete announcement confirm
surfaces.notes: Legacy: Popconfirm 'Delete this announcement?' with 'Placement cells stop seeing it.' confirmText='Delete'. vNext: TpoNoticeDeleteConfirm.

surfaces.name: TPO announcements page (Students tab + From 42 tab)
surfaces.notes: Legacy: tab='students' (own announcements grouped SCHEDULED/SENT/ENDED) and tab='from42' (from super admin). Left list + right detail pane. Groups: GOING OUT LATER, SHOWING NOW, ENDED. vNext: Tabs-based, TpoNoticeComposerDialog, TpoNoticeAudiencePicker.

surfaces.name: TPO announcement compose/create modal
surfaces.notes: AnnouncementComposer component. Fields: Title, Body, audience picker, button label/URL, showUntil, pinned, email toggle, sendAt for scheduling. vNext: TpoNoticeComposerDialog + TpoNoticeAudiencePicker.

surfaces.name: TPO announcement detail view (right pane)
surfaces.notes: Legacy: right pane shows picked announcement with reads progress, 'Who hasn't read' button, 'Remind them' button, edit/delete. State badges: pinned, scheduled, ended. vNext: TpoNoticeReadProgress, TpoNoticeDeliveryRetry.

surfaces.name: Learner placement announcements page (Announcements + Updates tabs)
surfaces.notes: Legacy: segment buttons 'Announcements' / 'Updates about you(N)'. Announcements from placement cell. Updates: round bookings, offers, applications, requests. vNext: AnnouncementFeed.

surfaces.name: Learner placement announcements — empty state
surfaces.notes: Legacy empty: 'No announcements from your placement cell yet.' / 'No updates yet. When a round is booked...'

surfaces.notes: No direct legacy equivalent. vNext has LearnerPlacementNotificationSettings component. Legacy had no preferences UI — this is vNext-only feature. Mark MISSING from legacy (vNext-new), not a gap.
